plan: Built off the room's crack line. Fake Out beats Prankster Gravity on speed (+3 over +1) and Prankster Taunt would fail into a Dark-type Sableye, so Incineroar's Fake Out is the honest turn-one denial. Dark pressure from three directions (Wicked Blow, Crunch, Dark Pulse) for Sableye, Banette, Dusknoir and Necrozma; Fighting and Ghost from Urshifu and Annihilape for Bronzor, whose Heatproof halves the Fire I would otherwise use. Annihilape's Vital Spirit is the sleep answer to a Gravity Hypnosis, and Rage Fist grows off the Sucker Punches the room is built on. Gyarados brings a second Intimidate before it Megas into a Mold Breaker Crunch that ignores Prism Armor. Flutter Mane is the fast Ghost for Mr. Mime and Necrozma.
